facts.statement: The dinosaur Sinusonasus was named and described by Xu Xing and Wang Xiaolin in 2004.
facts.quote: The type species, Sinusonasus magnodens, was named and described by Xu Xing and Wang Xiaolin in 2004.

facts.statement: Sinusonasus lived in what is now the Liaoning Province of China.
facts.quote: It lived in what is now the Liaoning Province of China.

facts.statement: Sinusonasus lived during the Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 million years ago in the Barremian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 125 millones de años, en el Barremiense

facts.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Sinusonasus to be one meter long and weigh 2.5 kilograms.
facts.quote: In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated its length at one metre, its weight at 2.5 kilogrammes.

facts.statement: The femur of Sinusonasus measures 141 millimeters in length.
The nasal bone of Sinusonasus has an undulating or wavy profile.
facts.quote: The nasal bone has an undulating profile.

facts.statement: The middle maxillary teeth of Sinusonasus are notably large.
facts.quote: The middle maxillary teeth are rather large.

facts.statement: The second toe of Sinusonasus bears a retractable sickle claw.
facts.quote: The second toe bears a retractable 'sickle claw'.

facts.statement: The second metatarsal bone is distinctly shorter than the fourth metatarsal bone.
facts.quote: El segundo metatarsiano es claramente más corto que el cuarto.

facts.statement: Sinusonasus had a long lower leg, suggesting it was capable of running well.
facts.quote: Sinusonasus has a long lower leg, indicating a good running capacity.
